events.what: Balogh, Bernshteyn, Delcourt, Ferber and Pham prove sunflower bounds for families of bounded VC-dimension, sharp (r-1)^k for VC-dimension 1
Ge, Wang, Xu and Zhao claim the conjecture for all families of bounded VC-dimension
Mishra claims the conjecture for shifted families
Fukuyama claims a full proof of the sunflower conjecture, repeatedly revised to fix errors
events.credibility_reason: Landmark problem; nearly four years with no expert uptake (none on Kalai's blog, which covers the topic, or MathOverflow); many patch revisions to 'fix the error' of the previous version; later same-topic work (Balogh et al., Ge et al.) treats the general conjecture as open. Also pre-snapshot, so could not set the status in any case.

events.what: Fukuyama claims a sunflower bound with a sub-logarithmic base
events.credibility_reason: Same author as the error-prone full-proof claim; no expert uptake recorded; record could not read full text.

judgement.doubts: Bounded-VC-dimension and shifted families are subclasses of the families the bullet quantifies over, so these are cases, not variants. Fukuyama's 2025 bound, even if correct, is progress tier and below partial. The Ge et al. date discrepancy (header 17 Jul 2026 vs 2609 ID) does not affect the status.
